reviews.comment:
Pase a cargar combustible y el playero que nos atendió muy educado y amable, dejo mi camioneta estacionada y pasamos a comer algo con mi familia, cuando salgo, me encuentro con otros dos playeros que estaban regando y me salpicaron toda la trompa de la camioneta con barro, mientras me miraban de reojo y se reían. Más allá que tuve que volver a lavar mi vehículo, no da para hacer esos chistes, oh! Si lo hiciste sin querer pedí disculpas como hombre y listo, pero lo hicieron adrede. La podés pasar mal o bien según la persona que te atienda.

(Translated by Google)
I stopped to fill up with gas, and the attendant who helped us was very polite and friendly. I parked my truck, and we went to get something to eat with my family. When I came out, I ran into two other attendants who were watering the road, and they splashed mud all over the front of my truck while looking at me sideways and laughing. Even though I had to wash my vehicle again, it's not right to make jokes like that. Oh! If you did it by accident, apologize like a man, and that's it. But they did it on purpose. You can have a bad or good experience depending on the person who serves you.
